definitions.T: AB plus 1e-7 metre stable routing tie tolerance only
definitions.H0: T plus full task cost and sampled terminal region, no next-anchor term
definitions.H05: H0 plus next-anchor term at weight 0.5
definitions.H1: H0 plus next-anchor term at weight 1
definitions.P1: H1 with terminal-region samples replaced by their geometric mean; no probability assumption

tuning_budget: Only the two preregistered lookahead weights; no post-holdout changes
selection_before_holdout: Select H05 or H1 by zero failures first, then lower development mean on bounded batch; tie-break with lower p95. Retain AB, T, H0 as controls. P1 remains a development ablation.
heldout_variants: AB, T, H0, selected H; exact files locked before fixture generation
acceptance_assessment: Zero missed sources, false completion and timeouts; report >=5% paired median gain and <=10% worst per-case regression as proposed targets, not contest rules. Never discard failures.
